seo.metaTitle: MEP Engineering Services | Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing | Engivato PLLC

items.title: Plumbing Engineering

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Have questions about our engineering deliverables, licensing, or turnaround times?

items.question: Do you provide stamped and sealed engineering drawings?
items.answer: Yes. All final construction document sets are stamped and sealed by Texas-licensed Professional Engineers (P.E.) in full compliance with TBPELS regulations, with mechanical engineering sealed in-house and electrical and plumbing engineering scopes coordinated and sealed through our trusted licensed engineering partners.

items.question: Can you deliver project models in Autodesk Revit?
items.answer: Absolutely. We develop projects in Autodesk Revit as standard practice, providing fully coordinated 3D BIM models for clash detection alongside traditional 2D AutoCAD deliverables.

items.question: How quickly can Engivato respond to plan review comments?
items.answer: We treat municipal plan review comments as top priority. Most plan check revisions are addressed within 2 to 4 business days to prevent permitting delays for owners and general contractors.

items.question: What building sectors and project types do you work on?
items.answer: Our core project focus is on restaurants, commercial office finish-outs, and multifamily developments, alongside retail fit-outs, medical suites, and commercial facility upgrades throughout Texas.
